request.style: English, choral, male baritone solo with mixed choir, organ, strings, timpani, harp, solemn and majestic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Gilgal to Bethel we went
Elijah said stay here my friend
But I said I will not leave you behind
As surely as the LORD lives he is kind

[Verse]
From Bethel to Jericho we go
The prophets ask if you know
The LORD will take your master away
I answered yes I know what they say

[Verse]
From Jericho to the Jordan stream
Fifty men watched as we walked in between
He rolled up his cloak and struck the water
The river divided for us to enter

[Verse]
As we crossed he asked what I need
Before he is taken by the decree
I asked for a double portion of your spirit
He said if you see it it will be it

[Verse]
A chariot of fire and horses of flame
Separated us in the sky's domain
I cried out my father where have you gone
I tore my clothes as I looked on

[Verse]
I picked up his cloak that fell from him
And stood on the bank of the Jordan rim
I struck the water with his coat
Where is the God of Elijah now

[Verse]
The water divided to right and to left
And I crossed over without effort or debt
The prophets saw and bowed to the ground
The spirit of Elijah is found
